description: Get one on-call schedule by id — {oncall:{_id, name, timezone, teams, users, activeShift, renderedShifts}}. `from` optionally sets the window start for rendered shifts. Spike: GET /on-calls/{oncallId} (team-scoped).

from.description: ISO timestamp to render upcoming shifts from (e.g. "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z").

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

name: spike_get_on_call
title: Get on-call schedule
